summary: Gold.com, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026 reporting entry into its Second Amended and Restated Uncommitted Credit Facility Agreement dated September 29, 2026, with CIBC Bank USA as administrative agent. The facility transitions to a demand-payable uncommitted revolving line of credit, shrinking capacity from $427.5 million to $250 million, while eliminating dividend, share-repurchase, acquisition, investment, metal-repurchase and secured-metals-lease caps and enlarging inventory and counterparty limits. This is a routine credit-agreement amendment, not a special situation; no board recommendation, transaction price, premium, or deadline applies.
